# Affordable Vet Care, for Every Pet.

Snout helps clinics offer monthly wellness plans so pet owners can say “yes” to recommended care without financial stress.

![Two white cards with rounded corners; left card has an orange shield with a paw icon above text stating 'Trusted By 2,500+ Providers Nationwide' and five orange stars below; right card shows an orange sync icon with text 'Avg Visit Frequency 5.7 per year' and notes a 72% increase from last year plus the phrase 'Unlimited Visits = Better Care'.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/693bd4682e5af459ea2aba6c/695fa418c93fcf3754756ecd_Group%202147229338.png)

![Two info boxes: left shows a shield icon with a smiley face and five stars titled 'Trusted By 2,500+ Providers Nationwide'; right shows 'Avg Visit Frequency 5.7 per year' with a note of +72% vs. last year.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/693bd4682e5af459ea2aba6c/6966140bb835aa93c0ad548e_Group%202147229340.avif)

### ~40% Increase in Vet Care Cost Since Jan 2020

Rising prices have led to a decline in visit frequency and compliance.

## Pet owners avoid the vet due to cost. that changes now.

Meanwhile, clinics shoulder the emotional and financial fallout — write-offs, payment plans, and heartbreaking conversations at the front desk.

With Snout, pet owners enroll with no credit checks, clinics are paid upfront at the time of care, and you never have to watch a pet go untreated.

## How Snout works

We believe every pet deserves care. Every vet deserves support. Every family deserves to say "yes" without fear. Snout is the infrastructure that makes that possible.

Step 1

#### Create Your Plans

Snout partners with veterinarians to create wellness plans that fit your pricing, codes, and practice.

![List of veterinary services including Vaccines, Heartworm Test, Fecal Screen, Blood Work, and highlighted Office Exams with an orange infinity symbol.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/693bd4682e5af459ea2aba6c/6989b23bc06fc2d192a92e09_step1.avif)

Step 2

#### Pet Owners Choose

Pet owners confidently say “yes” to your recommendations and choose a plan seamlessly with zero-cost hesitation.

![Three subscription plans labeled Puppy Plan $55/mo, Adult Plan $45/mo with a 'Selected' tag, and Senior Plan $60/mo on a green gradient background.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/693bd4682e5af459ea2aba6c/6989b268054be2921099a346_step2.avif)

Step 3

## Lasso MD Dental Marketing FAQ's

Why is Lasso MD the best dental marketing solution?

What sets Lasso MD apart is our unparalleled transparency and accountability in lead generation. We don't just bring you leads; we verify each one to see if it converts into an appointment and how much revenue you gain. It's a repeatable and predictable system that ensures you're not just getting traffic, but actual patients.

How much should a dental practice spend on marketing?

Investing in your practice's growth is non-negotiable. While the industry average hovers around 3-5% of revenue, we find those numbers don't always cut it. For organic marketing, expect to invest between $10,000 and $50,000 annually, depending on your market competition. When it comes to Paid Ads, it's not a one-size-fits-all budget. For a single practice, annual ad spend typically ranges from $15,000 to $100,000, with most practices landing in the $30,000-$60,000 zone. Multi-location groups can scale well beyond that as they expand into new markets. The key is to find your ROI sweet spot and continue increasing budget until hitting diminishing returns.

What are the best ways to get new patients from Google?

Visibility is just the start; conversion is the game-changer. With Lasso MD, you get a blend of SEO, targeted Google Ads, and a website rich in custom content, photos, and videos. It's not just about attracting clicks; it's about turning those clicks into loyal patients.

Do I need to use custom photos and videos on my website?

Yes, and here's why: Custom visuals give potential patients a real, authentic look into your practice. Our elite team of photographers and videographers make it effortless to upgrade your online presence, setting you apart from competitors.

How can I check if my marketing company is worth the money?

With Lasso MD, you'll never be in the dark. Our ROI Dashboard and Patient Leads CRM offer real-time metrics that show exactly how your marketing efforts translate into patient revenue. No guesswork, just clear, actionable insights.

What is dental marketing and why does my practice need it?

Dental marketing is the strategic use of SEO, paid advertising, website design, social media, and reputation management to attract new patients to your practice. Without it, you're relying on word-of-mouth alone. Lasso MD provides an end-to-end dental marketing solution, from custom websites to PatientLoop™ growth software, that creates predictable, measurable new patient revenue streams.

How do I choose the right dental marketing company?

Look for a dental-specific agency with transparent pricing, proven ROI tracking, and a full-service offering that covers websites, SEO, paid ads, and lead management. Lasso MD is the only dental marketing company that pairs expert marketing with PatientLoop™, an integrated ROI and growth platform that ensures a tangible return, so you always know exactly what your marketing investment is producing.

What results should I expect from dental marketing in the first 6 months?

Within the first 30–60 days, most Lasso MD clients see improved search rankings, increased website traffic, and more inbound patient calls. By 6 months, practices typically experience significant new patient growth with measurable ROI. Over 90% of our customers achieve a 3X–5X return on investment within the first 12 months, tracked down to the dollar through PatientLoop™.

Does Lasso MD integrate with my Practice Management Software?

Yes. PatientLoop™ connects with virtually every dental practice management system, including Dentrix, Dentrix Ascend, Open Dental, Eaglesoft, Denticon, Curve, Easy Dental, PracticeWorks, and 200+ others. This PMS integration is what makes Lasso MD a true closed-loop marketing system: we track every lead from the first click or call, through scheduling, all the way to completed appointments and actual production revenue in your practice management software. Most dental marketing agencies stop at clicks, calls, or form fills - we close the loop by connecting your marketing spend end-to-end to the real dollars it produces. No guesswork, no extrapolations, just verified ROI down to the dollar.
